sourceFile: 51. BRS-161014  Report test VP mold #4,#7,#8 change mold temperature and valcunizing agent 10% date 17.7.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable source evidence but the changed-factor and outcome grouping are not reliable enough for Ask AI.
issues: Primary change factor is misgrouped and mixes mold IDs, test rounds, temperature, and normal molds.
VP mold #4 is part of the test but is partly omitted from the changed condition.
FO normal mold data is incorrectly used as title/context for this VP temperature validation.
Several measurement outcomes are header-derived or nonsensical rather than valid result comparisons.
Evidence rows cite headers or partial rows without enough linked data for computed stats.
correctionPlan: Set primary factor to test VP molds #4/#7/#8 at 180°C vs 190°C with 150°C 1h cure and vulcanizing agent 10%, compared to normal VP where present.
Keep mold number, test round, temperature, date, line, lot date, and normal mold as subgroup keys.
Rebuild NG laser cutting and function outcomes from actual data rows, including #4/#7/#8 and normal rows.
Remove or separately validate FO and NTI measurement sections unless tied to the same validation context with real data rows.
Replace header-only/stat artifacts with row-cited result tables and decision rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row IDs exist, but citations are insufficient because several support only headers or misgrouped data.
